title: State of San Andreas Penal Code
note: Revised draft: subject to change until FreestyleRP staff sign it off.

charges.title: Assault
charges.description: A person who threatens another with violence, causing reasonable fear of imminent harm.

charges.title: Aggravated Assault
charges.description: Assault committed with a deadly weapon or with intent to cause serious injury.

charges.title: Assault on a Government Employee
charges.description: Assault against an on-duty government employee.

charges.title: Aggravated Assault on a Government Employee
charges.description: Assault with a deadly weapon against an on-duty government employee.

charges.title: Brandishing of a Firearm
charges.description: Displaying a firearm in a threatening manner in public without lawful reason.

charges.title: Battery
charges.description: Unconsented harmful or offensive physical contact causing minor or no injury.

charges.title: Aggravated Battery
charges.description: Battery causing serious injury, or committed with a weapon or other aggravating factor.

charges.title: Battery on a Government Employee
charges.description: Battery against an on-duty government employee.

charges.title: Reckless Endangerment
charges.description: Conduct showing reckless disregard that creates a substantial risk of serious injury to another.

charges.title: Gang Related Shooting
charges.description: Discharging a firearm during a confrontation between gang members.

charges.title: Involuntary Manslaughter
charges.description: Killing another person without intent, through criminal negligence or recklessness.

charges.title: Voluntary Manslaughter
charges.description: Intentional killing in the heat of passion following adequate provocation.

charges.title: Unlawful Imprisonment
charges.description: Restraining another person's movement without lawful justification.

charges.title: Kidnapping
charges.description: Taking and holding a person against their will by force, threat or deception.

charges.title: Medical Malpractice
charges.description: A licensed medical provider whose negligent care causes serious harm.

charges.title: Cannibalism
charges.description: Consuming, or forcing another to consume, human flesh.

charges.title: Torture
charges.description: Deliberately inflicting severe physical or mental pain on another person for any purpose.

charges.title: Attempted 1st Degree Murder
charges.description: A premeditated attempt to unlawfully kill another person.

charges.title: Accomplice to Attempted 1st Degree Murder
charges.description: Knowingly participating in or aiding a premeditated murder attempt.

charges.title: Attempted 2nd Degree Murder
charges.description: An attempt to unlawfully kill another person without premeditation.

charges.title: Accomplice to Attempted 2nd Degree Murder
charges.description: Knowingly participating in or aiding a non-premeditated murder attempt.

charges.title: Attempted Murder of a Government Employee (1st Degree)
charges.description: A premeditated attempt to kill an on-duty government employee.

charges.title: Attempted Murder of a Government Employee (2nd Degree)
charges.description: A non-premeditated attempt to kill an on-duty government employee.

charges.title: Accomplice to Attempted Murder of a Government Employee (1st Degree)
charges.description: Knowingly participating in or aiding a premeditated attempt on an on-duty government employee.

charges.title: Accomplice to Attempted Murder of a Government Employee (2nd Degree)
charges.description: Knowingly participating in or aiding a non-premeditated attempt on an on-duty government employee.

charges.title: 2nd Degree Murder
charges.description: The unlawful killing of another person with intent but without premeditation.

charges.title: Accomplice to 2nd Degree Murder
charges.description: Knowingly participating in or aiding a 2nd degree murder.

charges.title: Accessory to 2nd Degree Murder
charges.description: Helping a person who committed 2nd degree murder avoid arrest or conviction, after the fact.

charges.title: 1st Degree Murder
charges.description: The premeditated, unlawful killing of another person.

charges.title: Accomplice to 1st Degree Murder
charges.description: Knowingly participating in or aiding a premeditated murder.

charges.title: Accessory to 1st Degree Murder
charges.description: Helping a person who committed 1st degree murder avoid arrest or conviction, after the fact.

charges.title: Murder of a Government Employee
charges.description: The intentional killing of an on-duty government employee.

charges.title: Accomplice to Murder of a Government Employee
charges.description: Knowingly participating in or aiding the murder of an on-duty government employee.

charges.title: Accessory to Murder of a Government Employee
charges.description: Helping a person who murdered a government employee avoid arrest or conviction, after the fact.

charges.title: Serial Assaults and Killings
charges.description: Three or more separate attempted or completed 1st degree murders in separate incidents.

charges.title: Hostage Taking
charges.description: Holding a person against their will to force a third party to act or refrain from acting.

charges.title: Elder Abuse
charges.description: Willfully causing harm to, or neglecting the care of, an elderly person, or placing them in dangerous conditions.

charges.title: Aggravated Battery on a Government Employee
charges.description: Battery causing serious injury, or with a weapon, against an on-duty government employee.

charges.title: Criminal Threats
charges.description: Threatening, verbally or in writing, to kill or seriously injure another, causing sustained fear. No imminence required.

charges.title: Threats Against a Government Employee
charges.description: Criminal threats directed at a government employee or their family because of their role.

charges.title: Vehicular Manslaughter
charges.description: Killing another person through grossly negligent or unlawful operation of a vehicle.

charges.title: Vehicular Assault
charges.description: Causing serious injury to another through grossly negligent or unlawful operation of a vehicle.

charges.title: Domestic Battery
charges.description: Battery committed against a spouse, partner, family member or cohabitant.

charges.title: Attempted Kidnapping
charges.description: An attempt to kidnap that fails before the victim is taken.

charges.title: Accessory to Attempted 1st Degree Murder
charges.description: Helping a person who attempted a premeditated murder avoid arrest or conviction, after the fact.

charges.title: Accessory to Attempted 2nd Degree Murder
charges.description: Helping a person who attempted a non-premeditated murder avoid arrest or conviction, after the fact.

charges.title: Accessory to Attempted Murder of a Government Employee
charges.description: Helping a person who attempted to murder a government employee avoid arrest or conviction, after the fact.

charges.title: Leaving Without Paying
charges.description: Obtaining goods or services (fuel, food, lodging) under $500 and leaving without paying. $500 or more: charge 2002.

charges.title: Petty Theft
charges.description: Taking property worth less than $1,000 belonging to another with intent to deprive them of it.

charges.title: Grand Theft
charges.description: Taking property worth $1,000 or more belonging to another with intent to deprive them of it.

charges.title: Tampering with a Vehicle
charges.description: Damaging, entering or tampering with a vehicle or its contents without the owner's consent.

charges.title: Joyriding
charges.description: Temporarily taking or driving a vehicle without the owner's consent, without intent to keep it.

charges.title: Grand Theft Auto
charges.description: Taking a vehicle without consent with intent to permanently deprive the owner of it.

charges.title: Petty Robbery
charges.description: Taking property from a person by force or implied threat, without a weapon.

charges.title: Robbery
charges.description: Taking property from a person or business, including banks and ATMs, by force or threat.

charges.title: 2nd Degree Aggravated Robbery
charges.description: Robbery committed with a weapon.

charges.title: 1st Degree Aggravated Robbery
charges.description: Robbery that causes physical injury to any person.

charges.title: Robbery of a Financial Institution
charges.description: Using force or forced entry to take funds from a bank or listed financial institution.

charges.title: Possession of Stolen Goods
charges.description: Possessing property known or reasonably believed to be stolen, or valuables with no proof of ownership.

charges.title: Theft of a Commercial Aircraft
charges.description: Taking a commercial aircraft without the owner's consent.

charges.title: Theft of an Aircraft
charges.description: Taking any private aircraft without the owner's consent.

charges.title: Possession of Dirty Money (1st Degree)
charges.description: Possessing more than $15,000 of Dirty Money (defined in General Provisions).

charges.title: Possession of Dirty Money (2nd Degree)
charges.description: Possessing up to $15,000 of Dirty Money (defined in General Provisions).

charges.title: Possession of a Stolen Identification
charges.description: Possessing another person's identification without their consent.

charges.title: Sale of Stolen Property
charges.description: Selling, or offering to sell, property known or reasonably believed to be stolen.

charges.title: Carjacking
charges.description: Taking a vehicle from its driver or occupant by force or threat.

charges.title: Robbery of an Armored Vehicle
charges.description: Robbing an armored transport vehicle or its crew. May be charged alongside other applicable charges.

charges.title: Theft of a Government Vehicle
charges.description: Taking a police, fire, EMS or other government vehicle without authorisation.

charges.title: Theft of a Firearm
charges.description: Taking a firearm belonging to another person or business.

charges.title: Theft from a Vehicle
charges.description: Taking property, including car stereos, from inside another person's vehicle.

charges.title: Looting
charges.description: Theft during a riot, natural disaster or declared state of emergency.

charges.title: Operating a Chop Shop
charges.description: Dismantling, altering or selling stolen vehicles or their parts.

charges.title: Providing False Information to a Peace Officer
charges.description: Giving a false name, date of birth or identity to a peace officer while detained or under arrest.

charges.title: Impersonating a Government Employee
charges.description: Wearing a government uniform, displaying credentials, or performing official duties without authorisation.

charges.title: Identity Theft
charges.description: Using another person's identifying information for gain or to avoid liability.

charges.title: Extortion
charges.description: Obtaining money, property or an official act through force, threats or blackmail.

charges.title: Fraud
charges.description: Deceiving another person for gain of less than $1,000. $1,000 or more: charge 3011.

charges.title: Forgery of Documents
charges.description: Creating, altering or using false official or legal documents.

charges.title: Money Laundering
charges.description: Concealing the source of illegally obtained money or property.

charges.title: Voter Fraud
charges.description: Voting unlawfully, or using intimidation or bribery to influence a vote or election.

charges.title: Racketeering
charges.description: Committing a pattern of felonies on behalf of, or to profit, a criminal enterprise.

charges.title: RICO
charges.description: Leading or participating in a criminal enterprise that commits two or more qualifying felonies.

charges.title: Felony Fraud
charges.description: Deceiving another person for gain of $1,000 or more.

charges.title: Counterfeiting Currency
charges.description: Making or possessing equipment to make fake currency.

charges.title: Passing Counterfeit Currency
charges.description: Knowingly using or possessing counterfeit currency.

charges.title: Cheque Fraud
charges.description: Writing, altering or cashing a cheque knowing it to be forged or without funds to cover it.

charges.title: Credit Card Fraud
charges.description: Using a stolen, forged or cancelled credit card, or card details, without authorisation.

charges.title: Insurance Fraud
charges.description: Making a false or exaggerated insurance claim, including staged accidents or thefts.

charges.title: Bank or Wire Fraud
charges.description: Defrauding a financial institution, or using telephone, fax or wire transfers to defraud.

charges.title: Unauthorized Access to a Computer System
charges.description: Accessing a computer, network or database without authorisation, or exceeding authorised access.

charges.title: Illegal Wiretapping
charges.description: Intercepting or recording a telephone call or radio communication without consent or a warrant.

charges.title: Telephone Fraud
charges.description: Tampering with payphones or phone lines, or using devices to obtain phone service without paying.

charges.title: Bootlegging and Counterfeit Goods
charges.description: Making or selling pirated tapes, VHS or software, or goods bearing fake brand marks.

charges.title: Odometer Fraud or VIN Tampering
charges.description: Altering a vehicle's odometer or vehicle identification number.

charges.title: Smuggling
charges.description: Bringing goods into the state while avoiding customs or duties, including cigarettes and alcohol.

charges.title: Trespassing
charges.description: Entering or remaining on private property without permission after notice to leave.

charges.title: Felony Trespassing
charges.description: Unlawfully entering restricted government property, including power plants.

charges.title: Arson
charges.description: Deliberately starting a fire or explosion that damages property.

charges.title: Attempted Arson
charges.description: An attempt to commit arson where no fire was started.

charges.title: Reckless Burning
charges.description: Recklessly starting a fire that endangers life or property.

charges.title: Criminal Mischief Involving Fire
charges.description: RETIRED. Use 4003 (intentional) or 4005 (reckless).

charges.title: Tampering with Fire Safety Equipment
charges.description: Disabling, damaging or misusing fire alarms, extinguishers or sprinklers.

charges.title: False Reporting of a Fire
charges.description: RETIRED. Use 6006 (False Reporting).

charges.title: Fireworks Violations
charges.description: Selling or using fireworks in restricted areas or during a fire ban.

charges.title: Fire Lane Violation
charges.description: Parking or stopping in a marked fire lane.

charges.title: Burglary
charges.description: Entering a building or structure with intent to steal or commit a felony. Covers break-ins (B&E).

charges.title: Criminal Mischief
charges.description: RETIRED. Use 4013 (Destruction of Property) or 6001 (Vandalism).

charges.title: Destruction of Property
charges.description: Willfully damaging private property worth $1,000 or more, or damage that affects public safety.

charges.title: Aggravated Arson
charges.description: Arson of an occupied structure or vehicle, or arson that causes injury.

charges.title: Graffiti
charges.description: Marking, painting or tagging property without the owner's consent.

charges.title: Bribery
charges.description: Offering, giving or accepting a benefit to influence a public servant's official act.

charges.title: Introducing Contraband into a Government Facility
charges.description: Bringing unauthorised items into Bolingbroke Penitentiary or another government facility.

charges.title: Escaping Custody
charges.description: Escaping after being lawfully detained or arrested, before processing.

charges.title: Prison Break
charges.description: Escaping from prison, or helping a prisoner escape.

charges.title: Attempted Prison Break
charges.description: An attempt to escape from prison, or to help a prisoner escape.

charges.title: Perjury
charges.description: Knowingly making a false statement under oath.

charges.title: Embezzlement
charges.description: Fraudulently using business or government funds entrusted to you.

charges.title: Unauthorized Practice of Law
charges.description: Practising law without a BAR licence.

charges.title: Unauthorized Practice of Medicine
charges.description: Practising medicine without a licence.

charges.title: Unlawful Gambling
charges.description: Taking part in unlicensed gambling.

charges.title: Misuse of Emergency Systems
charges.description: Calling emergency services when there is no emergency.

charges.title: Conspiracy
charges.description: Two or more people agreeing to commit a crime, and at least one taking a step towards it. Penalty: 50% of the target offence.

charges.title: Violating a Court Order
charges.description: Willfully disobeying a lawful court order, including restraining orders.

charges.title: Failure to Appear
charges.description: Failing to appear in court when lawfully summoned.

charges.title: Contempt of Court
charges.description: Disobedience or disrespect towards the court during proceedings.

charges.title: Operation of a Business without a License
charges.description: Operating a business without a valid licence, or failing to display it.

charges.title: Tampering with the State Power Grid
charges.description: Attempting to damage, disable or shut off the state power grid.

charges.title: Government Corruption
charges.description: A public official abusing their office for personal gain.

charges.title: Failure to Pay Fines
charges.description: Failing to pay a lawful fine within 14 days.

charges.title: Witness Tampering
charges.description: Persuading or bribing a witness to give false testimony or not to appear.

charges.title: Witness Intimidation
charges.description: Threatening or using force against a witness or their family to influence testimony.

charges.title: Retaliation Against a Witness or Juror
charges.description: Harming or threatening a person because they testified or served on a jury.

charges.title: Jury Tampering
charges.description: Attempting to influence a juror outside of court proceedings.

charges.title: Parole Violation
charges.description: Breaching the conditions of parole.

charges.title: Probation Violation
charges.description: Breaching the conditions of probation.

charges.title: Bail Jumping
charges.description: Failing to appear in court after release on bail.

charges.title: Operating an Illegal Gambling Enterprise
charges.description: Running or profiting from unlicensed gambling.

charges.title: Official Misconduct
charges.description: A government employee knowingly acting outside their authority, or refusing a lawful duty.

charges.title: Excessive Force Under Color of Law
charges.description: A government employee using more force than reasonably necessary while acting in an official role.

charges.title: Unauthorized Disclosure of Government Records
charges.description: Leaking, selling or misusing police or government records or database information.

charges.title: Tax Evasion
charges.description: Willfully avoiding taxes owed to the state.

charges.title: Solicitation
charges.description: Asking, hiring or encouraging another person to commit a felony. Penalty: 50% of the target offence.

charges.title: Criminal Attempt
charges.description: A direct step towards committing a crime that is not completed. Penalty: 60% of the target offence, unless the code lists a specific attempt charge.

charges.title: Vandalism
charges.description: Damaging property owned by another worth less than $1,000.

charges.title: Vandalism of Government Property
charges.description: Damaging government property worth less than $1,000.

charges.title: Disobeying a Peace Officer
charges.description: Refusing to comply with a lawful order from a peace officer.

charges.title: Disorderly Conduct
charges.description: Behaviour that causes public alarm or inconvenience.

charges.title: Disturbing the Peace
charges.description: Fighting, unreasonable noise or provocative words in public.

charges.title: False Reporting
charges.description: Knowingly reporting a crime, fire or emergency that did not happen.

charges.title: Harassment
charges.description: A pattern of aggressive, unwelcome pressure or intimidation.

charges.title: Stalking
charges.description: Repeatedly following or threatening a person, causing them to fear for their safety.

charges.title: Misdemeanor Obstruction of Justice
charges.description: Recklessly hindering an investigation or legal process.

charges.title: Felony Obstruction of Justice
charges.description: Intentionally hindering an investigation or legal process.

charges.title: Inciting a Riot
charges.description: Urging a group of 4 or more to commit violence or property damage.

charges.title: Destruction of Government Property
charges.description: Damaging government property worth $1,000 or more.

charges.title: Evidence Tampering
charges.description: Destroying, hiding, altering or planting evidence.

charges.title: Public Nuisance
charges.description: Interfering with the public's use of a public space.

charges.title: Sightseeing on a Crime or Active Scene
charges.description: Loitering at an active emergency or crime scene after being told to leave.

charges.title: Assembly of a Paramilitary Organization
charges.description: Forming or joining an armed, unsanctioned militia that aims to influence government policy.

charges.title: Aiding and Abetting
charges.description: Knowingly helping another person commit a crime.

charges.title: Mischief
charges.description: RETIRED. Use 6004 (Disorderly Conduct) or 6001 (Vandalism).

charges.title: Concealment of Identity in a Public Space
charges.description: Refusing to remove a face covering after a lawful request.

charges.title: Unlawful Assembly
charges.description: Remaining in a gathering after police lawfully order it to disperse.

charges.title: Participating in a Riot
charges.description: Taking part in a violent public disturbance by 4 or more people.

charges.title: Gang Participation
charges.description: Actively participating in a criminal street gang while knowing its members commit crimes.

charges.title: Loitering
charges.description: Remaining in a public place without lawful purpose after being told to move on.

charges.title: Curfew Violation
charges.description: Being in a public place during a declared curfew.

charges.title: Harboring a Fugitive
charges.description: Hiding a person known to be wanted for a misdemeanour or felony. Capital fugitives: 8023.

charges.title: Public Intoxication
charges.description: Being intoxicated in a public place.

charges.title: Littering
charges.description: Leaving trash on the ground.

charges.title: Public Indecency
charges.description: Lewd conduct or indecent exposure in public.

charges.title: Misdemeanor Possession of Shrooms
charges.description: Possessing psilocybin mushrooms at or below the Drug Schedule threshold.

charges.title: Misdemeanor Possession of Marijuana
charges.description: Possessing marijuana at or below the Drug Schedule threshold (1 oz / 28 g).

charges.title: Misdemeanor Possession of Heroin
charges.description: Possessing heroin at or below the Drug Schedule threshold (1 g).

charges.title: Misdemeanor Possession of Oxy/Meth
charges.description: Possessing oxycodone or methamphetamine at or below the Drug Schedule threshold (15 units) without a prescription.

charges.title: Cultivation of Marijuana
charges.description: Growing marijuana plants, or possessing unprocessed cannabis or 25+ seeds.

charges.title: Felony Possession of Shrooms
charges.description: Possessing psilocybin mushrooms above the Drug Schedule threshold.

charges.title: Felony Possession of Marijuana
charges.description: Possessing marijuana above the Drug Schedule threshold.

charges.title: Felony Possession of Cocaine
charges.description: Possessing cocaine above the Drug Schedule threshold (3.5 g).

charges.title: Sale of Marijuana Seeds
charges.description: Selling or offering to sell marijuana seeds.

charges.title: Felony Possession of Oxy/Meth
charges.description: Possessing oxycodone or methamphetamine above the Drug Schedule threshold without a prescription.

charges.title: Felony Possession of LSD Tabs
charges.description: Possessing LSD above the Drug Schedule threshold (3 tabs).

charges.title: Possession of Drug Paraphernalia
charges.description: Possessing items used to prepare or consume drugs.

charges.title: Possession with Intent to Distribute
charges.description: Possessing drugs with signs of distribution (packaging, scales, large cash, lists).

charges.title: Sale of Drugs
charges.description: Selling or offering to sell a controlled substance.

charges.title: Drug Trafficking
charges.description: Large-scale transport, supply or distribution of controlled substances as part of an ongoing operation.

charges.title: Desecration of a Human Corpse
charges.description: Mutilating, hiding or improperly disposing of human remains.

charges.title: Grave Robbing
charges.description: Removing a body or items from a grave without authorisation.

charges.title: Human Trafficking
charges.description: Transporting, holding or selling people for forced labour or exploitation.

charges.title: Prostitution
charges.description: Offering or performing sexual acts for payment.

charges.title: Animal Cruelty
charges.description: Intentionally harming wildlife or animals.

charges.title: Poaching
charges.description: Killing or skinning protected wildlife.

charges.title: Forgery of Medical Documents
charges.description: Falsifying prescriptions or medical records.

charges.title: Misdemeanor Dumping
charges.description: Dumping a large amount of litter in a public place, creating a nuisance.

charges.title: Felony Dumping
charges.description: Intentionally dumping large items that harm the environment.

charges.title: Hazardous Felony Dumping
charges.description: Improperly disposing of hazardous or toxic material in San Andreas.

charges.title: Leaving a Fire Unattended
charges.description: Leaving a fire or coals that are not properly extinguished.

charges.title: Negligence that Leads to an Uncontrolled Fire
charges.description: Careless use of fire that spreads to wildland.

charges.title: Intentional Forest Fire
charges.description: Deliberately starting a fire in a forest or park.

charges.title: Disobedience of State Ordinance (Fire Ban)
charges.description: Lighting a fire during an advertised fire ban.

charges.title: Destruction of Woodlands
charges.description: Damaging trees or parkland. Tagging: see 4015.

charges.title: Handle Dairy Products in a Suspicious Manner
charges.description: Inaccurately testing dairy products to defraud.

charges.title: Aggravated Grave Robbing
charges.description: Grave robbing involving exhumation or other aggravating factors.

charges.title: Felony Possession of Heroin
charges.description: Possessing heroin above the Drug Schedule threshold (1 g).

charges.title: Hunting Without a License
charges.description: Hunting without a valid hunting licence.

charges.title: Hunting Outside Designated Hours
charges.description: Hunting outside the hours in the hunting regulations.

charges.title: Hunting Under the Influence
charges.description: Hunting with a weapon while intoxicated.

charges.title: Over Hunting
charges.description: Exceeding the animal limit in the hunting regulations.

charges.title: Fishing Without a License
charges.description: Fishing without a valid fishing licence.

charges.title: Possession of Illegal Fish
charges.description: Possessing dolphins, sharks, whales or other protected species.

charges.title: Overfishing
charges.description: Exceeding the catch limit in the fishing regulations.

charges.title: Animal Endangerment
charges.description: Failing to remove an animal from known danger.

charges.title: Felony Animal Endangerment
charges.description: Knowingly exposing an animal to danger.

charges.title: Hunting Outside of Posted Areas
charges.description: Hunting outside designated hunting zones.

charges.title: Misdemeanor Possession of LSD
charges.description: Possessing LSD at or below the Drug Schedule threshold (3 tabs).

charges.title: Misdemeanor Possession of Cocaine
charges.description: Possessing cocaine at or below the Drug Schedule threshold (3.5 g).

charges.title: Domestic Animal Cruelty
charges.description: Intentionally harming a domesticated animal.

charges.title: Unsafe Transporting of Animals
charges.description: Endangering animals while transporting them in a vehicle.

charges.title: Unlawful Manufacturing of a Controlled Substance
charges.description: Producing a controlled substance without a licence.

charges.title: Misdemeanor Possession of a Controlled Substance
charges.description: Possessing any Drug Schedule substance without its own charge (e.g. crack, PCP, MDMA) at or below its threshold.

charges.title: Felony Possession of a Controlled Substance
charges.description: Possessing any Drug Schedule substance without its own charge above its threshold.

charges.title: Selling Alcohol or Tobacco to a persons under 21
charges.description: Selling or supplying alcohol or tobacco to a person under 21 (alcohol) or 18 (tobacco).

charges.title: Pandering
charges.description: Recruiting, managing or profiting from another person's prostitution.

charges.title: Bootleg Alcohol
charges.description: Making or selling alcohol without a licence or without paying duty.

charges.title: Jaywalking
charges.description: Crossing a road outside a crosswalk or against the signal.

charges.title: Resisting Arrest
charges.description: Fleeing on foot, or as a passenger, from a lawful detention or arrest.

charges.title: Criminal Use of a Firearm
charges.description: Discharging a firearm without lawful reason, or during a crime.

charges.title: Brandishing a Non-Firearm Weapon
charges.description: Displaying a deadly weapon other than a firearm in a threatening way.

charges.title: Criminal Possession of a Melee Weapon
charges.description: Possessing a melee weapon not sold at Ammu-Nation.

charges.title: Criminal Possession of a Firearm [Class 1]
charges.description: Possessing an unlicensed or unregistered Class 1 firearm (handgun).

charges.title: Criminal Possession of a Firearm [Class 2]
charges.description: Possessing a Class 2 firearm (shotgun or automatic weapon).

charges.title: Criminal Possession of a Firearm [Class 3]
charges.description: Possessing a Class 3 firearm (LMG, RPG, DMR). Hunting rifles excluded.

charges.title: Criminally Negligent Ownership of a Firearm
charges.description: Failing to report the loss or theft of a licensed firearm within 24 hours.
charges.penalties: Weapons licence suspended/Possibly charged with whatever crime occured with the weapon.

charges.title: Criminal Sale of a Firearm [Class 1]
charges.description: Unlawfully selling or buying a Class 1 firearm.

charges.title: Criminal Sale of an Illegal Weapon
charges.description: Selling or buying a Class 2 or Class 3 firearm.

charges.title: Weapons Trafficking
charges.description: Transporting firearms in large quantities for distribution.

charges.title: Flying into Restricted Airspace
charges.description: Flying into or landing in restricted airspace without authorisation.

charges.title: Piloting Without a Proper License
charges.description: Operating an aircraft without a valid pilot's licence.

charges.title: Possession of Weapon Attachments
charges.description: Possessing silencers, extended magazines or similar attachments. Charged per attachment.

charges.title: Possession of a Molotov
charges.description: Possessing or transporting a Molotov cocktail.

charges.title: Possession of Explosives
charges.description: Possessing or transporting explosive devices.

charges.title: Criminal Use of Explosives
charges.description: Placing or detonating explosives. Attempted murder may also be charged.

charges.title: Criminal Possession of Government Issued Equipment
charges.description: Possessing government or police equipment (radios, uniforms, badges, armour, tools) without authorisation.

charges.title: Stockpiling
charges.description: Keeping 6 or more Class 2/3 firearms, Molotovs or explosives in one place.

charges.title: Criminal Possession of a Government-Issued Firearm
charges.description: Possessing a government-issued firearm without being a sworn officer authorised to carry it.

charges.title: Terrorism
charges.description: Using violence or intimidation against civilians or government to pursue political or ideological aims.

charges.title: Harboring a Capital Fugitive
charges.description: Hiding a person known to be wanted for a capital offence. Other fugitives: 6025.

charges.title: Treason
charges.description: Levying war, rebellion or insurrection against the State of San Andreas.

charges.title: In Control of a Dangerous Animal
charges.description: Keeping or controlling an animal that is a threat to the public.

charges.title: Unlawful Manufacturing of Weapons
charges.description: Manufacturing firearms without a licence.

charges.title: Possession of a Firearm by a Prohibited Person
charges.description: Possessing any firearm while prohibited (convicted felon or subject of a restraining order).

charges.title: Carrying a Concealed Weapon Without a Permit
charges.description: Carrying a concealed firearm without a CCW permit.

charges.title: Firearm in a Prohibited Place
charges.description: Bringing a firearm into a school, courthouse, government building or posted area.

charges.title: Drive-By Shooting
charges.description: Discharging a firearm from a vehicle at a person, vehicle or building.

charges.title: Defacing a Firearm Serial Number
charges.description: Removing, altering or possessing a firearm with a removed serial number.

charges.title: Possession of Burglary Tools
charges.description: Possessing lockpicks, slim jims or similar tools with intent to break in.

charges.title: Bomb Threat or Hoax Device
charges.description: Threatening to use an explosive, or placing a device meant to look like one.

charges.title: Interfering with Emergency Communications
charges.description: Jamming, blocking or transmitting on police, fire or EMS radio frequencies.

charges.title: Possession of a Police Scanner During a Crime
charges.description: Using or carrying a radio scanner tuned to emergency frequencies while committing a crime.

charges.title: Reckless Operation of an Aircraft
charges.description: Flying in a way that endangers people or property.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Driving While Intoxicated
charges.description: Driving while impaired by alcohol or drugs, or with a BAC of 0.08 or more.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Evading
charges.description: Failing to stop for police lights and sirens.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Reckless Evading
charges.description: Fleeing police while driving dangerously or endangering others.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Failure to Yield to Emergency Vehicle
charges.description: Not pulling over for an emergency vehicle using sirens or lights.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Failure to Obey Traffic Control Devices
charges.description: Ignoring regulatory signs or signals.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Negligent Driving
charges.description: Disregarding traffic rules. Applies when 3 or more traffic infractions occur in one stop.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Reckless Driving
charges.description: Driving with gross disregard for the safety of others.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Third Degree Speeding
charges.description: Up to 15 mph over the limit.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Second Degree Speeding
charges.description: 16–30 mph over the limit.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: First Degree Speeding
charges.description: More than 30 mph over the limit.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Illegal Modification of a Vehicle
charges.description: Neon underglow, xenon headlights, fully black tint or nitrous on a road vehicle.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Illegal Turn
charges.description: Rolling turns, failure to yield while turning, or banned left turns.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Illegal Passing
charges.description: Passing on the shoulder or median, or over a solid line.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Driving on the Wrong Side of the Road
charges.description: Driving against the flow of traffic.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Failure to Stop
charges.description: Not coming to a full stop at a stop sign or red light.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Unauthorized Parking
charges.description: Parking unsafely or illegally. Vehicle may be towed. Fire lanes: 4010.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Driving with a Suspended or Revoked License
charges.description: Driving while your licence is suspended or revoked. Failing to show a licence: 9021.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Hit and Run
charges.description: Leaving the scene of a crash causing property damage without identifying yourself.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Felony Hit and Run
charges.description: Leaving the scene of a crash causing injury or death.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Misuse of a Rental Vehicle
charges.description: Using a rental vehicle in the commission of a crime, or breaching the rental agreement.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Operating a Motor Vehicle Without Proper Identification
charges.description: Failing to present a licence or ID on request while driving.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Unauthorized Operation of an Off-Road Vehicle
charges.description: Driving an off-road vehicle without a licence plate on public streets.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Street Racing
charges.description: Taking part in a speed contest on public roads.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Operation of an Unroadworthy Vehicle
charges.description: Driving a vehicle in unsafe condition (e.g. missing doors or hood, no lights).

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Driving on Sidewalk or Pedestrian Area
charges.description: Driving on sidewalks, in parks or in pedestrian areas.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Obstruction of Traffic
charges.description: Blocking lanes or roads.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Stunt Driving
charges.description: Burnouts, drifting or other exhibitions that endanger others.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Improper Use of Horn
charges.description: Unnecessary or harassing use of the horn.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Unsafe Transport of Persons
charges.description: Carrying passengers unsafely (e.g. on the outside of the vehicle).

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Driving Without a License
charges.description: Driving without ever having held a valid licence.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Unregistered Vehicle
charges.description: Driving a vehicle with no registration or no plates.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Open Container
charges.description: An open container of alcohol in the passenger area of a vehicle.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: DUI Causing Injury
charges.description: Driving while intoxicated and causing injury to another person.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Boating Under the Influence
charges.description: Operating a boat while impaired or with a BAC of 0.08 or more.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Operating a Vessel Without a License
charges.description: Operating a boat without a valid boating licence.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Failure to Use Headlights
charges.description: Driving at night or in poor visibility without headlights.

charges.chapter: Offenses Involving Operation of a Vehicle
charges.title: Failure to Wear a Seatbelt
charges.description: Driver or passenger not wearing a seatbelt.
